_comment: Example MCP server configuration. Copy this file to .mcp.json (gitignored) and authenticate each connector via its OAuth flow on first use. Only enable the entries the team actually needs — read docs/integrations.md before adding more.
_authoritative_pm_tool_options: document — pm/backlog.md is the source of truth (default)
linear — Linear is the source of truth; pm/backlog.md is regenerated
jira — Jira is the source of truth; pm/backlog.md is regenerated
notion — Notion database is the source of truth; pm/backlog.md is a reference

linear._use: Backlog ticket source-of-truth or mirror; orchestrator can list/update issues.

atlassian._use: Jira (tickets) + Confluence (pages); single OAuth covers both.

notion._use: Docs / decision log mirror; pages and databases.

slack._use: Outbound dispatch summaries from the orchestrator. Don't scrape Slack for ticket state.

github._use: Structured GitHub access; complement to gh CLI for PR/issue/CI orchestration.
github._self_host: Can also be self-hosted. See repo for instructions.

figma._use: Design system + screen sources for the Designer and Frontend personas.
